# Nespresso Uruguay

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Official Nespresso online store for Uruguay, built on Shopify. Sells Nespresso coffee capsules, coffee machines and accessories. States shipping to any part of the country for orders above a stated threshold, dispatch within 24 hours, and pickup through pickup points and boutiques.
